fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League Military has long fielded some of the largest infantry formations in the Inner Sphere, with regiments numbering nearly 1,800 soldiers compared to roughly 750 in the Combine and just over 1,000 in the Federated Suns. Hover-mechanized platoons are the fastest infantry transport in FWLM service, carrying troops across water and open terrain at speeds that outpace any ground vehicle. Their vulnerability to ambush in confined terrain is offset by the tactical flexibility they offer on League worlds with extensive coastlines or open plains. Carrying infantry-portable long-range missile systems, these platoons provide indirect fire capability that extends their engagement envelope well beyond personal weapons range, though the weight and bulk of the launchers reduce the platoon's mobility.
